shortDescription: GOP Rep. Mariannette Miller-Meeks is a retired Army lieutenant colonel. "Vulnerable GOP Iowa Incumbents Break With Trump on Iran War," at 10:25 am ET, incorrectly said she is a retired Army lieutenant.
